name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability

labels: enhancement

**Problem**
What pain does this solve? Who is affected?

**Proposed solution**
Describe the feature and how it fits the existing architecture
(router chain, registry, policy, executor, server).

**Alternative approaches**
Anything you considered instead.

**Scope
- [ ] Fits within V1 (current)
- [ ] V2 roadmap item (semantic routing, docker/http, sandboxing, remote registries)
- [ ] V3 ecosystem item

**Checklist**
- [ ] I understand the [roadmap](ROADMAP.md) — I am not proposing a "second MCP registry" or "agent framework" scope
- [ ] I can help implement or test
